archetypes.name: dyn-threshold-accounting
archetypes.rationale: Dynamic/static slot threshold semantics are easy to regress.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed threshold accounting in python/review_pipeline.py. Focus on collector-first precedence, dynamic dropped-slot counting, static straggler exemption, and intended/launched slot denominator behavior. Check double dyn-prefix and codex twin naming paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-retry-warnings
archetypes.rationale: Warning surfacing now spans review core and review-and-fix retry state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review dynamic dropped-reviewer warning propagation across review_pipeline.py and review_and_fix.py. Focus on degraded retry accumulation, STRAGGLER_DROPPED_COUNT qualification, duplicate warning avoidance, and static-only straggler suppression. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-run-log-drops
archetypes.rationale: New committed dropped artifacts must stay bounded and redacted.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review dropped-slot artifact preservation in agent_waterfall.py, run_logs.py, SECURITY.md, and docs/run-logs.md. Focus on raw sidecar exclusion, diagnostic filename safety, redaction staging, and progress_report.py label reconstruction from committed artifacts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
